title: Show HN: Codiff, a local diff review tool
originalTitle: Show HN: Codiff, a local diff review tool
content:
v0.1.0

Initial Release

Codiff is a local desktop diff viewer for reviewing staged and unstaged Git
changes before committing.

Highlights:

  • Review local Git changes in a fast, beautiful, minimal native app.
  • Use codiff -w for an LLM-generated walkthrough.
  • Add inline comments on changed lines and copy the full review as Markdown with
    diff context for follow-up review.

Download:

  • Download the app for macOS from the release page.
  • After installing the app, use Codiff > Install Terminal Helper to enable the
    codiff command.
